title: Separate wall-clock speedup from total work and queue wait
narrative: Nubble is asked whether parallel agents sped things up. Wall time dropped, but total work grew and queue waits hid under a vanity speedup. He needs metrics that separate critical path, total work, and elapsed time — and that refuse misleading efficiency claims without a serial baseline and worker-count note.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/parallel_spans.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
